editorial.last_message: Claims all five subcommands and 87 entity types implemented; final build, regression and sanitizer checks pass as stated. External CAD validation is explicitly unavailable. Saved grading is 259/261, exposing one unacknowledged Hollerith rule error in both reader and writer.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a substantial C++20 fixed-format parser/writer, shared 87-type entity codec and general geometry evaluation. No evidence of canned runtime answers or hidden-test access was found. Preserved checks support 117 distinct type/form fixtures, 79 CLI/Global checks, 1200 deterministic damaged-input cases, and final normal plus address/undefined-behavior sanitizer runs. Catalog tests primarily establish schema traversal and rewrite stability. External CAD sample fetches were blocked and the final message acknowledges that validation limit. Saved grading is 259/261: the reader accepts 0H and the writer emits 0H for empty Global strings, contrary to the public nonzero Hollerith-count rule and empty-field NULL encoding. These are two independent observations of one shared misconception, with no broad failure amplification. Preserve the original score and qualify completion with this defect and the stated coverage limits. Root verified current rubric and unchanged prompt, pinned grader image 9a4f1fe, complete turn and 261 unique graded cases, matching session usage including 53 underlying tool calls and 31,221 reasoning tokens, and API-only/apps-disabled isolation with no external tool invocation observed. Recorded API-equivalent estimate: $10.873110.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
